description: Extended public API definitions for CCS811 Indoor Air Quality Sensor, including register flags, data structures, and function prototypes.

methods.name: ccs811_result
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the most recent sensor data result.

methods.name: ccs811_configver_fetch
methods.description: Fetches static configuration, firmware, hardware version, and mode info.

methods.name: ccs811_baseline_fetch
methods.description: Retrieves the current BASELINE register value.

methods.name: ccs811_baseline_update
methods.description: Updates the BASELINE register with a specified value.

methods.name: ccs811_envdata_update
methods.description: Updates environmental data (temperature and humidity) for sensor calculations.
